Also I have rarely struggled to make a timely appointment. But the reception staff have always been the weak link. There have been a few instances of minor oversights on their part, not putting prescriptions through to Day Lewis when requested was a repeated inconvenience a few years ago but admittedly hasn’t happened lately; or the time that instead of checking me in for my appointment the receptionist cancelled it, I sat waiting for 45mins beyond my appointment time before approaching the desk and being told, without apology, that my appointment was cancelled.
